nodes.title: Books signup
nodes.note: Books landing reached from the Banking/Books toggle: marketing hero, Accounting basis (Cash/Accrual) segmented control, Chart of accounts select, and Try Mercury Books CTA. Sidebar items are dimmed until Books is set up.

nodes.title: Accounting basis help tooltip
nodes.note: Hovering the info icon next to Accounting basis explains Cash vs Accrual in two paragraphs.

nodes.title: Chart of accounts dropdown
nodes.note: Two options: Default (Recommended) and Import template.

nodes.title: Chart of accounts preview
nodes.note: Eye icon opens a modal table of the default chart: Ledger code, Ledger account, Type, Subtype, Debit / credit, each sortable, with a copy button on hover.

nodes.title: Creating your books
nodes.note: After Try Mercury Books the form fades out to the starfield background with a "Creating your books" spinner chip before redirecting to the Books home.

nodes.title: Books home with setup spotlight
nodes.note: First landing on the Books home shows a "Finish setting up Books" spotlight anchored to the Finalize setup chip.

nodes.title: Books home
nodes.note: Company dashboard after dismissing the spotlight: date range timeline (Jun 25 - Sep 25), Finalize setup chip, Cash / Expenses / Revenue columns with net cash flow, coverage, trend charts and By ledger account breakdowns; header has Add, Search, Keyboard shortcuts and avatar.

nodes.title: Finalize setup 1 of 3: linked accounts
nodes.note: Add other bank or credit accounts: list of linked external accounts with checkmarks and a + to link more.

nodes.title: Finalize setup: advancing from step 1
nodes.note: Right after Next on step 1 the modal keeps showing the linked-accounts list while the Next button turns into a loading pill. Step 2 (Add payment or payroll integrations: Stripe, PayPal, Gusto, each "Set up on <provider>’s site") followed; its OAuth tiles were not opened.

nodes.title: Finalize setup: loading step 3
nodes.note: Transition into step 3 shows "Finalize setup 3 of 3" with an empty body and a three-dot loader before the accountant options appear.

nodes.title: Invite my accountant selected
nodes.note: Choosing Invite my accountant reveals a Team member select pre-filled with Xavier Xyloto.

nodes.title: Setup complete
nodes.note: "You’re all set - We’ve invited your accountant to your Books workspace." while the header still reads Finalize setup 3 of 3 with a spinner.

nodes.title: Add menu
nodes.note: Global Add menu: Journal entry, Invoice, Bill, Rule, Tag; Import: Transactions, Journal entries; plus Account, Ledger account, Customer, Vendor.

nodes.title: Create journal entry drawer
nodes.note: Right drawer with Date, Description and a spreadsheet-style Line items grid (Ledger account, Debit, Credit, Memo, Tags) with two empty lines and totals row.

nodes.title: Journal entry empty-save error
nodes.note: Saving the blank entry shows a single "Please complete all required fields." line under the grid; no field is marked.

nodes.title: Ledger account picker
nodes.note: Editing a Ledger account cell opens a narrow grouped combobox; typing "Rent" ranks Other Current Assets first and the exact Rent match last.

nodes.title: Journal entry date picker
nodes.note: Calendar popover for the Date field, defaulting to Sep 25, 2026.

nodes.title: Balanced journal entry
nodes.note: Rent debit 1,250.00 and Cash and Cash Equivalents credit 1,250.00, totals balanced.

nodes.title: Journal entry created
nodes.note: After Save a "Successfully created the journal entry" toast appears and the drawer turns into the read-only entry with edit, delete and duplicate icons.

nodes.title: Command
nodes.note: AI command page: "Ask anything about your money" prompt box with suggestion chips Issue new card and Compare monthly balances.

nodes.title: Transactions
nodes.note: Tabs All / Bank / Credit card / Payments / Loans, dismissible "Categorization that keeps up with you" explainer, Review / Filters / Categorization method controls and a spreadsheet grid (Date, Account, Ledger account, Description, Tags, Amount).

nodes.title: Invoices
nodes.note: Warning banner "You have 3 non-USD invoices that won’t sync to Books…" with View invoices; grid of invoices with Draft, Overdue, Paid - Needs Action, Cancelled, Processing, Partially Paid, Paid and Open badges.

nodes.title: Customers
nodes.note: Customer list (Name, Email) under Invoices, with Add a customer split button.

nodes.title: Bills
nodes.note: Bill grid (Bill #, Vendor, Date, Due date, Status, Amount, Outstanding) with Paid, Open, Draft, Cancelled, Partially Paid badges; one bill has an em dash for its number.

nodes.title: Vendors
nodes.note: Vendor list (Name, Email, Type, Address) with info banner "Payment recipients automatically appear as vendors in Books." and Add a vendor.

nodes.title: Payroll (empty)
nodes.note: Empty state "Payroll account will show up here when it's connected" with Connect payroll CTA, drawn over grey skeleton rows of the pay-run grid.

nodes.title: Manual Journal Entries
nodes.note: Tabs All / Assets / Liabilities / Equity / Revenues / Expenses; grid with Date created, Date, Description, Debit and Credit ledger account, Amount. The new "September rent accrual" entry appears in row 12.

nodes.title: Balance Sheet
nodes.note: Working capital line chart and stacked asset/liability/equity bars, then Filters, frequency (Monthly), year and month chips over an expandable statement grid ending in Sep MTD.

nodes.title: Profit & Loss
nodes.note: Revenue / Expenses / Net profit bars and a monthly P&L grid with Total column.

nodes.title: Cash Flow Analysis
nodes.note: Ending balance line and Movement bars, then a per-account monthly grid starting with Starting Balance.

nodes.title: General Ledger
nodes.note: This Month filter, grid of Date, Ledger account, Contra accounts, Memo, Vendor / customer, Debit, Credit.

nodes.title: Reconciliation
nodes.note: Opens on Jupiter Checking 4455 (Auto-reconciled) for Aug: month chips with sparkle icons, Reconciled / Ending balance and Difference $0.00, transaction grid with running Balance.

nodes.title: Chart of Accounts
nodes.note: Tabs All / Assets / Liabilities / Equity / Revenues / Expenses; ledger grid with code, name, type, subtype, Debit / credit, opening balance; linked-bank rows carry a link icon.

nodes.title: Rules
nodes.note: Ordered categorization rules: Input, Condition, Outcome, Last applied, drag handles; one rule flagged Invalid because its ledger was deleted.

nodes.title: Accounts
nodes.note: Tabs All / Mercury / Bank / Credit / Payments / Payroll; account list with Auto-synced or Manual account badges and Bank / Credit type.

nodes.title: Books Details
nodes.note: Settings: Start date Sep 1, 2023, Accounting basis Cash, Close date Aug 25, 2026, Books subscription Free trial, Request to be matched with an accounting partner.

nodes.title: Tags
nodes.note: Tag list of #Engineering, #Marketing, #Operations, #Product, #Sales in the Department group, all Active.

nodes.title: Create categorization rule
nodes.note: Drawer with empty If and Then selects. Save renders at opacity 0.4 but is not disabled; clicking it with the form empty does nothing and shows no message.

nodes.title: Rule condition menu
nodes.note: If options with helper text: Amount, Description, To/From, Card, Team member, Category.

nodes.title: Rule outcome ledger picker
nodes.note: Then select filtered by "Software", grouped under Expense.

nodes.title: Rule filled
nodes.note: If Description contains Figma, then Software and Subscriptions; helper "Matches if description contains this text (case-insensitive)."

nodes.title: Rule saved
nodes.note: Drawer switches to read-only CATEGORIZATION RULE: If Description has Figma then 54020 - Software and Subscriptions, with edit and delete icons.

nodes.title: Transaction detail
nodes.note: $14,934.67 Money out, Transaction / Journal Entry tabs, account, type, date, description, memo, line items and ACH metadata; the grid behind narrows so Ledger cells show "Un…" and "C".

nodes.title: Transaction journal entry tab
nodes.note: Journal Entry tab: Date, Description and a "Line entries" debit/credit table (Ops / Payroll credit, Uncategorized Cash Outflow debit).

nodes.title: Review filter menu
nodes.note: Review dropdown with To review and Reviewed radio items.

nodes.title: To review filter applied

nodes.title: Invoice detail
nodes.note: INV-OVERDUE-001: Details / Payments / Journal Entries tabs, Overdue badge, amount $4,200.00, dates Aug 11, 2026 and Sep 10, 2026, line items, outstanding balance, attachment dropzone.

nodes.title: Bill detail
nodes.note: BILL-001 (Open, $8,250.55): Due date shows "-" although the list shows 08/31/2026; line items table has no Amount column value in Total.

nodes.title: Search or jump to
nodes.note: Global search with All / Pages / Accounts / Ledgers / Transactions / Journal entries / Invoices / Bills chips. Query "rent" lists three "Cur-rent" ledgers, recent items and transactions, but not the Rent ledger.

nodes.title: Keyboard shortcuts
nodes.note: Searchable shortcut sheet: General (Search everywhere ⌘K, Show keyboard shortcuts ⌘S) and Grid shortcuts.

nodes.title: Create tag drawer
nodes.note: Create tag: Tag group Department, Tag name field with # prefix.

nodes.title: Tag empty-save error

nodes.title: Tag created

nodes.title: Ledger account detail
nodes.note: "10003 — Citi Checking 9384": code, account, type, subtype, Debit or credit, Parent (em dash), Opening balance $0.00.

nodes.title: Report frequency menu
nodes.note: Frequency options Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, Custom.

nodes.title: Balance Sheet by quarter
nodes.note: Quarterly view: Q1 2026, Q2 2026, Q3 QTD columns and Q1-Q3 chips.

nodes.title: Reconciliation account picker
nodes.note: Searchable account list grouped Bank accounts / Credit cards, each with Auto-reconciled or Not reconciled.

nodes.title: Account needing reconciliation

issues.title: Bill due date differs between list and detail
issues.detail: BILL-001 shows a due date of 08/31/2026 in the Bills grid, but its detail drawer shows no due date. The same bill is past due yet keeps the Open badge, while past-due invoices get Overdue.
issues.evidence: Bills row: 'BILL-001 · Debug LLC · 08/31/2026 · 08/31/2026 · Open · 8,250.55'. Drawer field text 'Due date\n-' (char U+002D). Invoices row: 'INV-OVERDUE-001 · 08/11/2026 · 09/10/2026 · Overdue'.

issues.title: ⌘S means both Save and Show keyboard shortcuts
issues.detail: The keyboard shortcut sheet assigns ⌘S to Show keyboard shortcuts, while the journal entry, rule and tag drawers advertise ⌘S as Save in their tooltips.
issues.evidence: Shortcut sheet row 'Show keyboard shortcuts ⌘ S'; drawer tooltip accessible name 'Save Command key Command key S key S'.

issues.title: Rule Save looks disabled but is not
issues.detail: On an empty Create categorization rule drawer, Save is dimmed like a disabled button, yet it stays enabled for assistive tech and keyboard. Pressing it does nothing and gives no feedback.
issues.evidence: getComputedStyle(Save): opacity '0.4', background-color 'rgb(82, 102, 235)'; button.disabled false; aria-disabled null.

issues.title: Three sibling drawers validate empty forms three ways
issues.detail: Journal entry shows one form-level sentence and marks no field. Tag shows an inline field error without a period. Rule shows nothing at all.
issues.evidence: JE: 'Please complete all required fields.' under the grid. Tag: 'Tag name cannot be empty' (color rgb(252, 146, 180), 12px, weight 400) under the field. Rule: no alert text in the DOM after Save.

issues.title: Exact ledger matches rank below substring matches
issues.detail: In the journal entry ledger picker, typing "Rent" puts Other Current Assets first and the Rent ledger last. Global search for "rent" lists three ledgers that contain "cur-rent" and omits Rent.
issues.evidence: Picker options for 'Rent': 'Other Current Assets' [selected], 'Other Non-Current Assets', 'Other Current Liabilities', 'Other Non-Current Liabilities', 'Current Year Earnings', 'Rent'. Search Ledgers group: '15000 - Other Current Assets', '18000 - Other Non-Current Assets', '24900 - Other Current Liabilities'.

issues.title: Same dates shown in three formats
issues.detail: Grids use MM/DD/YYYY, drawers use "Mon D, YYYY", and the Rules Last applied column mixes "Mon D", MM/DD/YY and "Never" in one column.
issues.evidence: Transaction grid '09/27/2026' vs its drawer 'Sep 27, 2026'. Invoice grid '08/11/2026' vs drawer 'Aug 11, 2026'. Rules Last applied cells: 'Sep 25', 'Sep 24', '08/21/25', 'Never'.

issues.title: Money is formatted differently per surface
issues.detail: Amounts drop the currency symbol in grids, show it in drawers and search, round to whole dollars on the dashboard, and use superscript cents in Rules.
issues.evidence: Grid '−14,934.67' vs drawer '$14,934.67 Money out'; Journal Entries grid '1,250.00' vs search '$1,250.00'; dashboard 'Rent $519,514'; Rules condition '≥ $100.00' with '.00' raised.

issues.title: New journal entries default to tomorrow
issues.detail: The Date field of a new journal entry is pre-filled with the UTC date, not the local one. In the evening in the Americas that is tomorrow.
issues.evidence: Browser clock 'Thu Sep 24 2026 21:45:49 GMT-0700'; Date field value 'Sep 25, 2026'; dashboard range label 'Jun 25, 2026 – Tomorrow'.

issues.title: Setup says done while the indicator says 2 of 3
issues.detail: After Complete on step 3 the modal says "You’re all set" while its header keeps a spinner on "Finalize setup 3 of 3" and the chip’s accessible label reports two steps done.
issues.evidence: Confirmation text '✓ You’re all set' / 'We’ve invited your accountant to your Books workspace.'; header 'Finalize setup 3 of 3'; chip image alt '2 of 3 setup steps complete'.

issues.title: Report frequency listbox marks the wrong option selected
issues.detail: With the combobox reading Monthly, the open listbox exposes Annual as the selected option to assistive tech.
issues.evidence: combobox 'frequency': 'Monthly'; listbox: option 'Annual' [selected], option 'Quarterly', option 'Monthly', option 'Custom'.

issues.title: Books spells it Cancelled, Banking spells it Canceled
issues.detail: Status badges in Books invoices and bills use British "Cancelled"; the Banking side uses "Canceled" in its toasts, filters and transaction states.
issues.evidence: Books badges 'Cancelled' (INV-CANCELLED-001, BILL-CANCELLED-001). Banking invoicing toast 'Item canceled', URL param 'showCanceled=true'.

issues.title: Same date range uses an en dash and a hyphen
issues.detail: The dashboard subtitle and the timeline chip describe the same range with different separators.
issues.evidence: Subtitle 'Jun 25, 2026 – Tomorrow' (U+2013); chip 'Jun 25 - Sep 25' (U+002D). Code separators also vary: '10003 — Citi Checking 9384' (drawer title) vs '54020 - Software and Subscriptions' (rule outcome).

issues.title: Journal entries go by four names
issues.detail: The same feature is labelled differently in the sidebar, page title, Add menu, create button and search chip.
issues.evidence: Sidebar 'Journal Entries'; h1 'Manual Journal Entries'; Add menu 'Journal entry' / 'Journal entries'; button 'Create journal entry'; search chip 'Journal entries'.

issues.title: Same fields labelled differently in adjacent views
issues.detail: The two tabs of the transaction drawer name the same table differently, and the chart of accounts names the balance side differently in its grid and its drawer.
issues.evidence: Transaction tab 'Line items' vs Journal Entry tab 'Line entries'. Column header 'Debit / credit' vs drawer label 'Debit or credit'. Transactions tab 'Credit card' vs Accounts tab 'Credit'.

issues.title: Primary buttons mix Create, Add and Add a
issues.detail: Each list page names its primary action with a different pattern.
issues.evidence: 'Create invoice', 'Create bill', 'Create rule', 'Create tag', 'Create journal entry', 'Add a customer', 'Add a vendor', 'Add ledger account', 'Add account'.

issues.title: Success toasts use different phrasings
issues.detail: Creating a journal entry and creating a tag produce toasts in two styles.
issues.evidence: 'Successfully created the journal entry' vs 'Tag created'.

issues.title: Tags lose their # outside the Tags page
issues.detail: Tags render with a # prefix on the Tags page and in the tag drawer, but without it in the transactions grid.
issues.evidence: Tags page chips '#Marketing', '#Product'; transactions Tags cells 'Marketing', 'Product'.

issues.title: Open badge text does not match its tint
issues.detail: Paid, Overdue, Active and Auto-synced badges color their text in the badge hue; Open pairs neutral text with a teal tint.
issues.evidence: Open: color rgb(221, 221, 229), bg rgba(119, 190, 207, 0.2). Paid: color rgb(119, 197, 153), bg rgba(119, 197, 153, 0.2). Overdue: color rgb(252, 155, 111), bg rgba(252, 155, 111, 0.2). All 12px, radius 4px, padding 0 8px.

issues.title: Payroll empty state sits on top of loading skeletons
issues.detail: The Payroll page shows its empty-state message and Connect payroll button while skeleton rows keep rendering in the grid behind it, so the page reads as both loading and empty.
issues.evidence: Capture 26-payroll.png: grey skeleton bars under 'Pay period st…' headers behind 'Payroll account will show up here when it's connected'.

issues.title: Opening a drawer truncates grid labels to single letters
issues.detail: When a detail drawer opens, the list keeps all columns and truncates them, leaving ledger names unreadable and two dashboard rows both reading "Other…".
issues.evidence: Transactions Ledger cells 'Un…', 'C', 'I.' with drawer open; dashboard Expenses rows 'Other… $840,660' and 'Other… $629,296' beside the journal entry drawer.
